PREMIERE316 STYLE-ONLY IMAGE REFERENCE CONTROL — V2
Asset ID: fx-smoke-ash
Workflow profile: 2P39X1 (2.39:1)
Reference mode: ART DIRECTION ONLY — NO SUBJECT OR DESIGN TRANSFER.

The loaded images are non-content style plates. The asset prompt below is the sole authority for subject, identity, age, ethnicity, anatomy, wardrobe design, prop design, environment geometry, creatures, crowd population, pose, action, camera composition, wounds, blood placement, text, and all story content.

ALLOWED TRANSFER ONLY: overall palette; contrast curve; key/fill/rim relationship; volumetric-light behavior; atmosphere density; material highlight and shadow response; lens/exposure language; practical texture fidelity; cinematic depth; restrained film grain.

FORBIDDEN TRANSFER: faces or facial geometry; body identity or proportions; hairstyles; costume silhouettes; wounds or blood maps; weapons or props; architecture or set geography; creature designs; crowd layout; pose; framing; four-panel layout; lettering; logos; or any recognizable object from a reference, unless the asset prompt itself explicitly requests that exact element.

Atmosphere/VFX guard: transfer only light falloff, particle behavior, haze density, ember/gold color relationships, and cinematic exposure. Keep the effect content and compositing requirements controlled by this row.

Active plate roles: warm-gold lighting and highlight rolloff; smoky umber shadow palette and ember atmosphere; abstract filmic tonal/material response and restrained grain.
When a reference conflicts with the row prompt, ignore the reference and obey the row prompt.

AUTHORITATIVE ASSET PROMPT
--------------------------
FX-SMOKE-ASH — PRODUCTION REFERENCE: CINEMATIC VFX, PARTICLES, LIGHT, TRANSFORMATION, AND MOTION REFERENCE.

Photorealistic live-action production reference, physically coherent lighting, exact anatomy, clean hands, consistent scale and materials, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, and no written or graphical elements.

Cinematic production reference of Hell's continuous smoke-and-ash atmosphere for the biblical epic JESUS: THE HARROWING OF HELL, captured as a photoreal live-action VFX plate rather than illustration or stylized CGI. Thick stratified black smoke hangs in dense horizontal bands and rising columns through a vast subterranean fortress cavern—obsidian-black stone pillars half-lost in gloom, a ceiling three hundred feet above drowned entirely in rolling soot. The smoke is not clean charcoal vapor but heavy, greasy, millennia-old prison air: sooty gray-black volumes with dull brown undertones, oily density near the floor, thinner blue-gray veils higher up, slowly boiling as if stirred by a distant subterranean breath. Fine ash particles suspend throughout every cubic foot of air like gray snow that refuses to fall—irregular flakes of pale gray, charcoal, and bone-white dust, some drifting lazily, some hanging motionless in stagnant layers, catching every available photon. Blue hell-torches burn at intervals along black stone walls and pillar bases with cold spectral flame near 2000K (#4169E1), casting elongated dancing shadows and cutting narrow cones of cold illumination through the fog; each torch creates a visible volumetric shaft where smoke density becomes readable as layered sheets. Deep crimson underglow near 3500K (#8B0000) bleeds up from floor fissures and distant furnaces, staining the lowest smoke strata a bruised blood-red while the upper volumes remain near pure obsidian black (#0A0A0A). Continuity moment for the reference plate: the instant just after Hell's iron-and-bone gate has shattered and the Guardians have dissolved into smoke and ash—so the atmosphere is freshly charged with denser local plumes of armor-dissolution residue: coarser metallic-gray ash flakes, fine black soot from cracked corroded iron, and pale bone-dust threads swirling where towering guardian forms stood moments before, already merging into the permanent prison haze. Through the far breach, the first flood of divine golden light (#FFD700 to warm amber #FFBF00, roughly 6500K god-ray quality) begins to pierce the gloom; where those rays strike, individual ash particles and smoke edges ignite into brilliant golden scintillae—millions of tiny illuminated motes defining volumetric god-ray shafts that carve readable paths through the oppressive fog without yet purifying the whole chamber. Camera: 35mm anamorphic sensibility, 2.39:1 widescreen, slight low-to-eye-level wide establishing of atmosphere as hero subject, deep mid-ground haze with soft background falloff, shallow enough depth of field that near-field ash flakes render as soft glowing discs while mid-distance smoke retains sculptural volume. Composition prioritizes readable particulate layering, torch-cut tunnels of cold light, and the clash of cold blue torch light against the first golden divine intrusion. Texture and atmosphere: micro-detail of ash flake edges, oily smoke curl, dust motes in rim light, slight heat shimmer near torch heads, no rain or water vapor, dry dead-air particulate only. Color grade locks to hell-realm initial palette—deep crimsons, obsidian blacks, cold blue torch accents—with a controlled first kiss of ethereal gold where divine light enters. Sacred biblical-epic tone, oppressive then breached; physically coherent volumetric lighting; continuous smoke generation from ground-level vents and residual guardian-ash plumes; no human faces as primary subject, no modern objects, machinery, logos, text, watermarks, UI, borders, captions, or readable signage. Photoreal live-action production reference for compositing and atmosphere matching across fortress, gate, and inner-chamber shots. Continuity locks: blue flames until full transformation later; smoke remains dense black until divine light floods; guardian dissolution contributes extra ash density at this beat; iron-and-bone gate materials only in distant structural silhouettes if visible; single coherent atmosphere plate, no cartoon smoke, no neon colors, no sci-fi particles.
